register.labelZh: SHOW 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: show somebody around、in、out 和 over 可以用來談論接待訪客、帶人參觀,以及協助別人進出某個地方。；show something off 可以表示自豪地展示某物;show off 則可以描述刻意吸引別人注意的行為。；show up 可以描述某人到場、某物變得清楚可見,或某種顏色在另一種背景下特別顯眼。；show somebody up 可以表示令某人出醜;show somebody or something up as/for something 則可以揭露某人或某事物的真面目。
register.summaryEn: Show somebody around, in, out and over help you talk about welcoming visitors, giving tours and helping people enter or leave. Show something off describes proudly displaying something. Show off describes behaviour intended to attract attention. Show up can describe somebody arriving, something becoming visible or one colour standing out against another. Show somebody up can describe making someone look foolish. Show somebody or something up as/for something can reveal the truth about them.

questions.promptZh: 那個孩子抄了答案,但老師安靜地糾正他,以免令他在全班面前難堪。
questions.answer: The child had copied the answer, but the teacher corrected him quietly so that she would not show him up in front of the class.
questions.answerZh: 那個孩子抄了答案,但老師安靜地糾正他,以免令他在全班面前難堪。
